en.bdb: The sense of duality is a wrong bet

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਵੰਞੈ ਸਾਹੁਰੈ ਲੋਕਾਂ ਮਤੀਂ ਦੇ ਸਮਝਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: aap na va(n)n(j)ai saahurai lokaa(n) matee(n) dhe samajhaae|

en.bdb: The wicked girl herself does not go to her father-in-law's house but teaches others how to behave at in -laws' house.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਨਣੁ ਘਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਦੀਵਿਅਹੁਂ ਹੇਠ ਅੰਨੇਰੁ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਮਿਟਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: chaanan ghar vich dheeviahu(n) heTh a(n)ner na sakai miTaae|

en.bdb: Lamp can enlighten the house but it cannot dispel the darkness underneath itself.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਫੜਿ ਆਖੁੜੈ ਹੁਇ ਚਕਚਉਧੀ ਪੈਰ ਥਿੜਾਏ॥
verses.translit_en: hath dheevaa faR aakhuRai hui chakachaudhee pair thiRaae||

en.bdb: The man walking with lamp in hand stumbles because he is dazzled by its flame.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਥ ਕੰਙਣੁ ਲੈ ਆਰਸੀ ਅਉਖਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: hath ka(n)n(g)n lai aarasee aaukhaa hovai dhekh dhikhaae|

en.bdb: He who tries to see the reflection of his bracelet in a avast;

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੀਵਾ ਇਕਤੁ ਹਥੁ ਲੈ ਆਰਸੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਹਥਿ ਫੜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: dheevaa ikat hath lai aarasee dhoojai hath faRaae|

en.bdb: Mirror worn on the thumb of the same hand can hardly see it or show it to other.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁੰਦੇ ਦੀਵੇ ਆਰਸੀ ਆਖੁਰ ਟੋਏ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਜਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: hu(n)dhe dheeve aarasee aakhur Toe paau(n)dhaa jaae|

en.bdb: Now if he catches hold of a mirror in one hand and lamp in the other even then he would stumble into a pit.
Double-mindedness is an evil stake which ultimately causes defeat.
